Yea if Horla has E1, or else you lack a Vuln Source.

Second team *should* be fine. Just slap Keyflare WoDs and Life Drain on Ramona. You can alternatively run Burial on Saya to hit 100% DR. 

First team: 
Ogier should run “Land of Nonexistence”, and another WoD that increases “Shield”, or alternatively run Burial Grounds with “Dusk and Dawn” on Ogier.

I can see your trying to mitigate Oathbound’s card loss via Ryker Exalts, but I don’t think that’s a good idea. Due to Exalts costing 10 more Aliemus after every Exalt would be too much funneling to make him effective. Would probably run Saya Sig, and a Crit Rate/Support/DR WoD, or if its D-Tide, go full into two Crit Rate/Support/DR WoDs. For CoVs, Burial Grounds for 100% DR(or as close as you can get), Scarlet Embrace for Keyflare.

Minor note, I dislike Deus and Re-Evolution. Deus because value unless you kill in 1-4 turns. Re-Evolution because I care more for Burial Grounds always for DR chance.
